newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Rwanda tribunal postpones hearing for defence.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda tribunal postpones hearing for defence.

text.p: The International Criminal Tribunal on Rwanda postponed on Friday the start of the defence hearing for Jean Paul Akayesu from next Monday to May 21.
Akayesu, a former mayor and the first defendant on trial at the tribunal in Arusha, Tanzania pleaded not guilty to genocide and crimes against humanity in Rwanda during mass slaughter in 1994.
His trial had been postponed until next Monday from March 7 after 22 witnesses appeared for the prosecution. The maximum penalty that the U.N. tribunal can issue is life imprisonment.
